# Case 09: a solver-family subsection that mixes axes

Skill: write-related-work
Expected gates: G-RW-axis
Language: en

Snippet:

> C. Deep reinforcement learning for hybrid actions and constraints. Parameterized-action networks represent discrete and continuous choices together. Action masking removes infeasible choices before sampling. Lagrangian methods add a learned penalty weight. Hierarchical formulations split the decision into two stages, and recurrent encoders track the history of past states.

Why it fails: the categories mix action representation, constraint handling, decision process, and state encoding, so one work can sit in several categories.
